name: AATC-XKV: Attention-Aware Cross-Layer KV Cache Compression (Production-Read
description: AATC-XKV: Attention-Aware Cross-Layer KV Cache Compression (Production-Ready v2).  Real KV cache compression:   1. AATC sensitivity-weighted bit allocation (reverse waterfilling).   2. xKV cross-layer shared subspace via joint SVD on REAL calibration data.   3. DynamicCache subclass that stores int8 quantized coefficients instead of fp16 K/V.   4. Attention sink preservation (first token) + option
